=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:651-674 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: check_one() reads only the newest 100 completed workflow runs (`per_page=100`, no `head_sha` filter), so when more than 100 runs exist the merge-commit run (the oldest qualifying run) is never on the page. Inside the window the check stays `pending reason=runs_truncated`. After the window, the cut-off branch sets `fresh = None; run = None` and decide() returns `unverified`, so the check can never grade `held` or `recurred`.
  WHY: On a busy workflow, a failed merge-commit run never reopens or re-plans the issue: `ai:verify-pending` is removed and the outcome is recorded as unverified. Severity disagrees: minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash say MAJOR (high); anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 says NIT (low, confidence 3) because a candidate is usually graded while total_count is still small. The highest is used. openai_gpt-6-luna's finding also covers the misleading "no run" comment (unverified_comment(), lines 394-400). The suggested fixes are to add `&head_sha=<merge_sha>` to the query or to make one extra targeted read.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:391-400 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the cut-off page branch ends the check after the window, unverified_comment() posts "no run of `{marker['workflow']}` within {window_h} h", and the journal note (line 708/710 path) reads "check after merge unverified after N h". Both are factually wrong because many runs existed, and the note cannot be told apart from a workflow that never ran.
  WHY: An operator is pointed at a missing trigger instead of a busy workflow. test_check_truncated_runs_page_after_window_ends_unverified only asserts the header, so the wrong text is not caught. All three reviewers rated this NIT (low).

- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:check_one(), cut-off runs page branch, lines 666-674 (verified on current ref) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When the page is cut off (`total > len(page)`) with no merge-commit run, the check waits (`runs_truncated`) inside the window, then after it sets `fresh = None; run = None` and ends `unverified`. The query at lines 653-655 reads only the newest 100 runs (`created=>=merged_at`, no `head_sha` filter), so the merge-commit run is never inspected and a failure can never be graded `recurred`.
  WHY: With `total_count` 150, every tick in the window logs `pending reason=runs_truncated`, and the first tick after the window removes `ai:verify-pending` and posts `unverified` regardless of the run's conclusion. This breaks the agents.d Check bullet contract ("grades the first completed run that contains the merge"). Suggested fix: add `&head_sha={marker['merge_sha']}` to the query.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:unverified_comment(), lines 394-400, reached from the new terminal path at lines 672-673 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The comment reads "is unverified (no run of `{workflow}` within {window_h} h)" even though runs existed (`total_count > 100`), and the journal note matches the never-ran case.
  WHY: The comment is factually wrong and points operators at a missing trigger. `test_check_truncated_runs_page_after_window_ends_unverified` (tests/test_persist_postmerge_verify.py:392) only asserts the header.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2 related items): check_one() lines 653-655, append `&head_sha={quote(marker['merge_sha'], safe='')}` (2-3 lines); unverified_comment() lines 394-400 and call site line 708, optional reason suffix carried into `_journal` (~6 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
